priorityList: Cast Avenging Wrath on cooldown, ideally when the Expurgation dot is ticking on the target.
Cast Execution Sentence on a priority target if Wake of Ashes is ready to follow up.
Cast Wake of Ashes if it will not overcap Holy Power to enable Hammer of Light.
Cast Hammer of Light as your highest priority finisher, especially while Avenging Wrath or Undisputed Ruling is active.
Spend Holy Power on Divine Storm if you are at 5 Holy Power or if your free Hammer of Light proc is about to expire.
Cast Divine Toll on cooldown, ideally synchronized with Avenging Wrath.
Cast Blade of Justice if Art of War or Righteous Cause procs.
Cast Divine Storm as your primary Holy Power spender in AoE scenarios.
Cast Hammer of Wrath as a high-priority generator.
Cast Blade of Justice to generate Holy Power.
Cast Judgment to generate Holy Power and apply its debuff.
Cast Templar Strike and Templar Slash to generate Holy Power.
Cast Crusader Strike if no other generators are available.
Use Arcane Torrent if you need an additional point of Holy Power.
